bio: I’m FoxxUmi, a cute, slightly sly and chaotic streamer who loves story-driven games, vivid worlds, and cozy chats. Expect RPGs, shooters, live reactions, big emotions, and plenty of yelling at bosses. Come in, get comfy, and let’s experience it all together.
